0506c85e3131.en: Something soft and warm falls against his arm: Magi has fallen asleep. Harry looks at her cuteness, then notices her weapon and backpack. He asks if she's okay, but she doesn't respond. He shifts to make her more comfortable, and she suddenly wakes up.
0506c85e3131.t: Sesuatu yang lembut dan hangat jatuh menimpa lengannya: Magi tertidur. Harry menatap keimutannya, lalu memperhatikan senjata dan ranselnya. Ia bertanya apakah ia baik-baik saja, tapi ia tak menjawab. Harry bergeser agar ia lebih nyaman, dan ia tiba-tiba terbangun.

06ec9f6b1a65.en: Dalila, quietly eating, looks at Harry, then back at her food, taking another bite of the tender, juicy, slightly gamy Bagarisa. She starts staring intently at Harry's plate. "I can eat it for you." Nailah: "Desmond, can you give your Bagarisa to Dalila? I don't want to see food wasted."
06ec9f6b1a65.t: Dalila, makan dengan tenang, menatap Harry, lalu kembali ke makanannya, mengambil gigitan lain dari Bagarisa yang empuk, berair, dan sedikit berbau liar itu. Ia mulai menatap piring Harry dengan saksama. "Aku bisa memakannya untukmu." Nailah: "Desmond, bisa kamu berikan Bagarisa-mu kepada Dalila? Aku tidak mau melihat makanan terbuang."

0738030a5363.en: Nailah looks at her husband. "I think she'd have a better time somewhere without so many memories." Severino: "I was talking with Desmond earlier today. Maybe next time Yosuke stops by, we can see if he needs an assistant?" Dalila looks at them, Bagarisa juice on her chin, mouth full. "Who's that?" "The chef of The Wood People Picker."
0738030a5363.t: Nailah menatap suaminya. "Kurasa dia akan lebih baik di tempat yang tidak punya begitu banyak kenangan." Severino: "Tadi aku mengobrol dengan Desmond. Mungkin lain kali Yosuke mampir, kita bisa tanya apakah dia butuh asisten?" Dalila menatap mereka, sari Bagarisa di dagunya, mulut penuh. "Siapa itu?" "Koki The Wood People Picker."

0887c32d0f25.en: Harry needs to change his appearance, yet nobody seems to have noticed him so far. His beard makes him look different, so he marches on just fine.
0887c32d0f25.t: Harry harus mengubah penampilannya, tapi sejauh ini tampaknya tak ada yang menyadarinya. Janggutnya membuatnya tampak berbeda, jadi ia terus melangkah tanpa masalah.

0a20c05ba0a7.en: Harry #13 has breakfast outside with Takeo and a few others; Takeo's wagon nearby holds three bodies and the Bagarisa, all frozen in ice
0a20c05ba0a7.t: Harry #13 sarapan di luar bersama Takeo dan beberapa orang lain; gerobak Takeo di dekatnya berisi tiga jasad dan si Bagarisa, semuanya membeku dalam es

0a26181ee767.en: The Halfway Inn: Kibe and Eori

0bbc63c0d24f.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Why? Who are you?" "What are you talking about?" "I said, who the fuck are you?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} grabs him by the shoulders. "You don't remember? Magina guy? I'm {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}! I've known you for, like, twenty years!"
0bbc63c0d24f.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Kenapa? Kamu siapa?" "Kamu bicara apa?" "Aku bilang, kamu ini siapa, sialan?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} mencengkeram bahunya. "Kamu tidak ingat? Orang Magina? Aku {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}! Aku sudah kenal kamu, kira-kira, dua puluh tahun!"

0da86e9b0ecb.en: The two Saynas look at each other. The quiet one, Katsuki, turns and walks away from her sister. Katsumi, the rebel, grows sad as she lies there, searching for the words, but when she tries to speak, only cutesy noises come out. The quiet Sayna glances at her and keeps walking.
0da86e9b0ecb.t: Kedua Sayna saling menatap. Yang pendiam, Katsuki, berbalik dan berjalan menjauhi saudarinya. Katsumi, si pemberontak, menjadi sedih sambil berbaring di sana, mencari kata-kata, tapi saat ia mencoba bicara, hanya suara-suara imut yang keluar. Sayna yang pendiam meliriknya dan terus berjalan.

0daa26198a65.en: Dalila's eyes well up and she hugs the father and mother. "Thank you!" Harry, a bit embarrassed, hugs them too, while Dalila hugs Vitor and lifts him off the ground. Vitor looks out of breath; Harry kneels to his level, and they slap hands, then bump fists.
0daa26198a65.t: Mata Dalila berkaca-kaca dan ia memeluk sang ayah dan ibu. "Terima kasih!" Harry, agak malu, ikut memeluk mereka, sementara Dalila memeluk Vitor dan mengangkatnya dari tanah. Vitor tampak kehabisan napas; Harry berlutut setinggi dirinya, dan mereka saling tepuk tangan, lalu adu tinju.

0f0da724d2b8.en: Sora talks with the other maids in the kitchen
0f0da724d2b8.t: Sora berbicara dengan para pelayan lain di dapur

110ca8bfc9c0.en: He looks at Dalila again, with no idea what to talk about. "Hmm. What's your favorite food?" "Bagarisa." Harry nods, breathing out through his nose. "Makes sense." I guess she'd never be friends with them after all that— Images of the playful Bagarisas come to mind. I wish I could have killed the bandits and revived them instead. If only I was stronger. He interlocks his fingers, tightening the grip. If only.
110ca8bfc9c0.t: Ia menatap Dalila lagi, tak tahu harus membicarakan apa. "Hmm. Apa makanan favoritmu?" "Bagarisa." Harry mengangguk, mengembuskan napas lewat hidung. "Masuk akal." Kurasa dia tak akan pernah berteman dengan mereka setelah semua itu— Bayangan para Bagarisa yang suka bermain muncul di benaknya. Andai aku bisa membunuh para bandit itu dan menghidupkan mereka kembali. Andai saja aku lebih kuat. Ia menautkan jari-jarinya, mengeratkan genggamannya. Andai saja.

116b7af835b2.en: Harry #13 sits by Dalila while everyone eats out in the open; three bandits hang upside down
116b7af835b2.t: Harry #13 duduk di samping Dalila sementara semua orang makan di udara terbuka; tiga bandit digantung terbalik

12eb007cc2a4.en: Neferteri: "Oh, dear daughter, I knew you would accomplish this wonderful goal." Eori doesn't look happy. "From here we're heading to Forway, where you shall focus on your studies and clear your mind of past events." Eori looks even less happy.
12eb007cc2a4.t: Neferteri: "Oh, putriku tersayang, aku tahu kamu akan mencapai tujuan yang luar biasa ini." Eori tidak tampak senang. "Dari sini kita menuju Forway, tempat kamu akan berfokus pada studimu dan menjernihkan pikiranmu dari peristiwa-peristiwa lalu." Eori tampak makin tidak senang.

184d466e701a.en: Severino: "Hey, Vitor, can you take Dalila to her bed?" Vitor does, and Harry sees the defeated look on Dalila as she's carried away. Severino says Harry will sleep in the barn over there with the others, since nobody knows who's who yet. Harry nods.
184d466e701a.t: Severino: "Hei, Vitor, bisa kamu bawa Dalila ke tempat tidurnya?" Vitor melakukannya, dan Harry melihat raut kalah di wajah Dalila saat ia dibawa pergi. Severino bilang Harry akan tidur di lumbung di sana bersama yang lain, karena belum ada yang tahu siapa yang siapa. Harry mengangguk.

18c436416281.en: Magi stares him in the eyes, then turns her head away without a word, scoots closer to the person on her other side, clutches her backpack tighter, and ends up falling asleep bent forward. (Magi has narcolepsy, and she's rather distrustful of people.) Harry feels unwanted. Then he notices her clothes are tattered. Is she an adventurer? Her clothes look pretty worn for an adventurer.
18c436416281.t: Magi menatap matanya, lalu memalingkan kepala tanpa sepatah kata, bergeser lebih dekat ke orang di sisinya yang lain, mendekap ranselnya lebih erat, dan akhirnya tertidur membungkuk ke depan. (Magi mengidap narkolepsi, dan ia cukup sulit memercayai orang.) Harry merasa tidak diinginkan. Lalu ia memperhatikan pakaiannya compang-camping. Apa dia petualang? Pakaiannya tampak cukup usang untuk seorang petualang.

1a34b2a184dc.en: Takeo mentions he's leaving for Forway, and tells Desmond he really wanted him to try escaping yesterday. Harry: "I'm no bandit."
1a34b2a184dc.t: Takeo menyebut ia akan berangkat ke Forway, dan memberi tahu Desmond bahwa ia sangat ingin Desmond mencoba kabur kemarin. Harry: "Aku bukan bandit."

1af40ad1fd2c.en: Severino: "You two will catch the next wagon to Forway's South Entrance. Once you get there, ask for the restaurant. Make sure not to spend it all: you only have about 10 Pearls to spare."
1af40ad1fd2c.t: Severino: "Kalian berdua akan naik gerobak berikutnya ke Pintu Masuk Selatan Forway. Begitu tiba, tanyakan restorannya. Pastikan jangan menghabiskan semuanya: kalian hanya punya sekitar 10 Pearl untuk dibelanjakan."

1b3663a91979.en: A tug on her paddle: Kibe has used a hook on a long rod to attach his boat to hers, and he brings her into the city docks. Eori is thankful, but her moral fiber rejects the help. With a firm refusal, she heads for the endless-looking stairs.
1b3663a91979.t: Sebuah tarikan di dayungnya: Kibe memakai kait di tongkat panjang untuk menyambungkan perahunya ke perahu Eori, dan menariknya ke dermaga kota. Eori berterima kasih, tapi harga dirinya menolak bantuan itu. Dengan penolakan tegas, ia menuju tangga yang tampak tak berujung.

1be831e48243.en: Takeo talks with the Forway captain, who chews on a Steen stick with his feet up, guards around them
1be831e48243.t: Takeo berbicara dengan kapten Forway, yang mengunyah batang Steen dengan kaki di atas meja, para penjaga di sekitar mereka

1c6348ff337e.en: A crowd swarms the docks to watch Eori push a kayak into the water by herself; Kibe follows. Eori's will is iron. (It starts as swimming, but Eori uses her wits, and pity, to manipulate her way into a paddle boat.)
1c6348ff337e.t: Kerumunan memenuhi dermaga untuk menyaksikan Eori mendorong kayak ke air sendirian; Kibe mengikuti. Tekad Eori sekeras besi. (Awalnya berenang, tapi Eori memakai akalnya, dan rasa iba orang, untuk memanipulasi agar ia mendapat perahu dayung.)

1eceacc77d6b.en: Harry #12, half asleep on his side, wakes up while two others (weak and feeble on purpose) talk behind him
1eceacc77d6b.t: Harry #12, setengah tertidur menyamping, terbangun saat dua orang lain (lemah dan tak berdaya dengan sengaja) berbicara di belakangnya

2098054638d0.en: Dalila stops eating and walking, and her face falls. She puts the chip back in the bag. "Pappa taught me everything, including the shortcuts." Harry doesn't know what to say, and forces a smile. "They seem like nice people."
2098054638d0.t: Dalila berhenti makan dan berjalan, dan wajahnya muram. Ia memasukkan kembali keripiknya ke kantong. "Papa mengajariku semuanya, termasuk jalan-jalan pintas." Harry tak tahu harus bilang apa, dan memaksakan senyum. "Mereka tampaknya orang-orang baik."

240b0e084085.en: Yosuke: "So you two are the new ones, huh?" Harry and Dalila introduce themselves, and so do the two bartenders, Hanako and Mimi, and the sub chef, Rimir.
240b0e084085.t: Yosuke: "Jadi kalian berdua yang baru, ya?" Harry dan Dalila memperkenalkan diri, begitu pula kedua bartender, Hanako dan Mimi, dan sub-koki, Rimir.

24be5ed1659d.en: Deep in the night, Eori, curled up in a dirty blanket, stares at a paddle
24be5ed1659d.t: Larut malam, Eori, meringkuk dalam selimut kotor, menatap sebuah dayung

2605763bd534.en: Harry cuts fish, and Yosuke compares him to Dalila
2605763bd534.t: Harry memotong ikan, dan Yosuke membandingkannya dengan Dalila

262c3ef875d5.en: They walk slowly. Wagons and Eguas pass by. A whiff of manure drifts by now and then, but the ground is spotless by comparison: the poop bags really keep things clean.
262c3ef875d5.t: Mereka berjalan pelan. Gerobak dan Egua lewat. Sesekali bau kotoran hewan menyambar, tapi tanahnya bersih sekali sebagai perbandingan: kantong-kantong kotoran benar-benar menjaga kebersihan.

278f52910463.en: Ryo and an adventurer on the road with two Saynas that look like the sisters; one of them is silent as a rock
278f52910463.t: Ryo dan seorang petualang di jalan bersama dua Sayna yang mirip kedua saudari itu; salah satunya diam seperti batu

27f551044502.en: Harry tries the window, but it's sealed tight. Meanwhile, Takeo does the same to the other bandit, but instead of spitting it out, he savors it longer. "That's a good blend of Freeish and Sanbi."
27f551044502.t: Harry mencoba jendela, tapi tertutup rapat. Sementara itu, Takeo melakukan hal yang sama pada bandit yang lain, tapi alih-alih meludahkannya, ia menikmatinya lebih lama. "Itu perpaduan Freeish dan Sanbi yang bagus."

2c7d29222f38.en: Harry takes a deep breath. "What do you want from me?" "More fingers?" Harry tenses his hand. Takeo laughs. A knock at the door breaks the foul mood.
2c7d29222f38.t: Harry menarik napas dalam-dalam. "Apa maumu dariku?" "Lebih banyak jari?" Harry menegangkan tangannya. Takeo tertawa. Ketukan di pintu memecah suasana yang buruk itu.

331753b1badd.en: Harry passes a wall of posted quests, and sees an older picture of himself in the Sanbi eye
331753b1badd.t: Harry melewati dinding penuh misi yang dipasang, dan melihat gambar lama dirinya sebagai Sanbi Eye

3534416fbb8b.en: Huneo smiles. "This is my final request: she may use the Darfaries interface." Neferteri glances over the crowd; their eyes tell her she has no choice but to play along. She looks at Eori. "MOOOM! THAT'S UNFAIR!" Tears pool in Eori's eyes. Neferteri closes her eyes and slowly raises her badge, silencing the room. "On behalf of the Sanbi Royals, I declare this trial fair."
3534416fbb8b.t: Huneo tersenyum. "Ini permintaan terakhir saya: ia boleh memakai antarmuka Darfaries." Neferteri melirik kerumunan; tatapan mereka memberitahunya ia tak punya pilihan selain ikut bermain. Ia menatap Eori. "IBUUU! ITU TIDAK ADIL!" Air mata menggenang di mata Eori. Neferteri memejamkan mata dan perlahan mengangkat lencananya, membungkam ruangan. "Atas nama para Sanbi Royal, aku menyatakan pengadilan ini adil."

3789ad7de8a4.en: Harry focuses all his power into his hands, but nothing happens. The tingle in his spine that radiates down through his body is all there, but no flame comes out. Takeo lets out a single, mocking gasp of laughter. "Is that a new CQC?" "Huh?" "Close Quarters Combat. Show me!" Harry looks at his normal-looking hands and concentrates again. Nothing. "I—dunno. Haaa—"
3789ad7de8a4.t: Harry memusatkan seluruh kekuatannya ke tangannya, tapi tak terjadi apa-apa. Rasa geli di tulang punggungnya yang menjalar ke seluruh tubuhnya masih ada, tapi tak ada api yang keluar. Takeo mengeluarkan satu tawa mengejek. "Itu CQC baru?" "Hah?" "Close Quarters Combat. Tunjukkan!" Harry menatap tangannya yang tampak biasa dan berkonsentrasi lagi. Tidak ada. "Aku—tidak tahu. Haaa—"

37913a61d066.en: The adventurer, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}: "Why are you going to such lengths for these two?" Ryo: "'Cause I love 'em. Simple as that." "Even though they're Red Winga whores?" One of the Saynas scratches him. Ryo: "I agree with Katsumi! No need to shit-talk a legitimate profession."
37913a61d066.t: Si petualang, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}: "Kenapa kamu bersusah payah begini demi dua orang ini?" Ryo: "Karena aku sayang mereka. Sesederhana itu." "Meski mereka pelacur Red Winga?" Salah satu Sayna mencakarnya. Ryo: "Aku setuju dengan Katsumi! Tidak perlu menjelek-jelekkan profesi yang sah."

3871c378fc19.en: Takeo, Severino and a few others carry dead bodies wrapped in ice crystals, plus a large Bagarisa, as the sun rises
3871c378fc19.t: Takeo, Severino, dan beberapa orang lain membawa jasad-jasad yang dibungkus kristal es, ditambah seekor Bagarisa besar, saat matahari terbit

39aab094aed8.en: The captain moves the stick from one corner of his mouth to the other, takes it out (one end is full of teeth marks), snips that end off with scissors and puts it back in his mouth. "We had something not as bad as this before. A scientist was experimenting with nari gels full of all kinds of crap. He went berserk and killed about 20 people slightly north of Blood." The stick rolls to the other side of his mouth, and he interlocks his fingers. "But I don't remember him exploding like a Hifuna beast. In fact, he reverted when the guards pinned him down and injected him with a ton of Nari Refresher."
39aab094aed8.t: Sang kapten memindahkan batang itu dari satu sudut mulutnya ke sudut lain, mengeluarkannya (satu ujungnya penuh bekas gigitan), memotong ujung itu dengan gunting dan memasukkannya kembali ke mulut. "Kita pernah punya sesuatu yang tidak separah ini sebelumnya. Seorang ilmuwan bereksperimen dengan nari gel yang penuh segala macam omong kosong. Ia mengamuk dan membunuh sekitar 20 orang sedikit di utara Blood." Batang itu bergulir ke sisi lain mulutnya, dan ia menautkan jari-jarinya. "Tapi aku tidak ingat ia meledak seperti makhluk buas Hifuna. Malah, ia kembali normal saat para penjaga menahannya dan menyuntiknya dengan banyak sekali Nari Refresher."

3a4c3e09a898.en: He explains how much they'll earn and how much it costs to live at the restaurant. Food is covered, but work clothes aren't: they can pay up front, or it comes out of their salary. If they leave, they return the work clothes for a refund. If they don't, Yosuke has friends who will find them and get the clothes back, and you don't want to meet those friends. He also goes over the dress code and appearance rules.
3a4c3e09a898.t: Ia menjelaskan berapa yang akan mereka dapat dan berapa biaya tinggal di restoran. Makanan ditanggung, tapi pakaian kerja tidak: mereka bisa membayar di muka, atau dipotong dari gaji. Kalau mereka pergi, mereka mengembalikan pakaian kerja untuk mendapat uangnya kembali. Kalau tidak, Yosuke punya teman-teman yang akan menemukan mereka dan mengambil kembali pakaiannya, dan kamu tidak mau bertemu teman-teman itu. Ia juga menjelaskan aturan berpakaian dan penampilan.

3aa8ab17a5a9.en: Arc #3 - Tasty Lie: the author's story notes (spoilers).
3aa8ab17a5a9.t: Arc #3 - Dusta yang Lezat: catatan cerita penulis (spoiler).

3bc237421f16.en: July, Takeo and Francisco at the restaurant
3bc237421f16.t: July, Takeo, dan Francisco di restoran

3eaef02a7b3a.en: Severino shows Harry how they cut a tree; Harry follows suit, but isn't as strong. Severino mentions that his son usually comes with him, but right now he's way too gone over Dalila to care about anything else.
3eaef02a7b3a.t: Severino menunjukkan kepada Harry bagaimana mereka menebang pohon; Harry mengikuti, tapi tidak sekuat itu. Severino menyebut putranya biasanya ikut dengannya, tapi sekarang ia terlalu tergila-gila pada Dalila untuk peduli hal lain.

416463ad94bd.en: Severino asks if she has any family left. She doesn't. They invite her to stay and work with them for a while, until she gets back on her feet. Dalila nods; Vitor looks really happy.
416463ad94bd.t: Severino bertanya apakah ia masih punya keluarga. Ia tidak punya. Mereka mengajaknya tinggal dan bekerja bersama mereka untuk sementara, sampai ia bangkit lagi. Dalila mengangguk; Vitor tampak sangat senang.

461392bd3929.en: Ryo, the sisters (in nari gel form) and the adventurer are stopped by a Forway captain
461392bd3929.t: Ryo, kedua saudari itu (dalam wujud nari gel), dan si petualang dihentikan seorang kapten Forway

4643dde163a2.en: Harry #13 lies in the ferns, looking at the sun, trying to fall asleep
4643dde163a2.t: Harry #13 berbaring di antara pakis, menatap matahari, berusaha tertidur

4817400ac39a.en: Harry and Dalila in front of The Wood People Picker; Yosuke, the bartenders Hanako and Mimi, and the sub chef, Rimir, at the entrance
4817400ac39a.t: Harry dan Dalila di depan The Wood People Picker; Yosuke, para bartender Hanako dan Mimi, dan sub-koki, Rimir, di pintu masuk

49a010b459ce.en: Author's note: Eori is growing a spine, going through the same process Maiara and Yacamim went through. Neferteri tries to control the cycle, and is even growing self-aware of it, but part of her can't seem to stop trying to break the cycle in her favor. Eori, meanwhile, is going through the cycle in her own way, and has grown up in some sense, though her negative tendencies build toward emancipation more than just seeking freedom… In a sense, that's an attempt at control as well.
49a010b459ce.t: Catatan penulis: Eori mulai punya nyali, melewati proses yang sama yang dilalui Maiara dan Yacamim. Neferteri berusaha mengendalikan siklus itu, dan bahkan mulai menyadarinya, tapi sebagian dirinya tampaknya tak bisa berhenti berusaha memutus siklus itu demi keuntungannya. Eori, sementara itu, melewati siklus itu dengan caranya sendiri, dan dalam arti tertentu sudah tumbuh dewasa, meski kecenderungan negatifnya lebih mengarah ke emansipasi daripada sekadar mencari kebebasan… Dalam arti tertentu, itu juga upaya mengendalikan.

4bd1eb690337.en: Takeo grabs the two bandits by the hair and turns them toward Harry. "Do you know these two?" Harry shakes his head, straining to see their faces. "I—I—no. I—I don't know them." He keeps his distance. Takeo pulls their heads up to his height. "And you two? Do you know him?" Through their pained groans comes a strong, negative-sounding murmur.
4bd1eb690337.t: Takeo menjambak rambut kedua bandit itu dan memutar mereka menghadap Harry. "Kamu kenal dua orang ini?" Harry menggeleng, berusaha keras melihat wajah mereka. "Aku—aku—tidak. Aku—aku tidak kenal mereka." Ia menjaga jarak. Takeo mengangkat kepala mereka setinggi kepalanya. "Dan kalian berdua? Kalian kenal dia?" Di antara erangan kesakitan mereka terdengar gumaman kuat yang terdengar menyangkal.

4cef50db3806.en: Harry and Dalila at Forway's South Gate; down the street, a massive gate opens onto a road that seems to go on forever
4cef50db3806.t: Harry dan Dalila di Gerbang Selatan Forway; di ujung jalan, gerbang raksasa terbuka ke jalan yang tampak tak berujung

527bb2159c14.en: Harry #13 leaves the Bagarisa on his plate untouched and eats the rest
527bb2159c14.t: Harry #13 membiarkan Bagarisa di piringnya tak tersentuh dan memakan sisanya

573b136c0c22.en: She closes her eyes, and sees another trial just like this one, with her own father not protecting her. She's a princess, for fuck's sake. Why bother with the title and all that shit, when it's all a farce?
573b136c0c22.t: Ia memejamkan mata, dan melihat pengadilan lain yang persis seperti ini, dengan ayahnya sendiri tidak melindunginya. Ia putri, sialan. Buat apa repot dengan gelar dan semua omong kosong itu, kalau semuanya sandiwara?

584e5ac2504a.en: Harry: I think I understand her position, but there's no way I can talk about it without raising suspicion. "Can I ask what the story's about?" Severino tells the story of the three sisters, who came along and revolutionized Tolerideme's farming with Soul Energy and fish meal mixed with human poop. The tie-in: whatever their bodies looked like, those sisters had bright minds and wills as strong as rock. Severino is pushing Harry (and Vitor) to think about the mind behind the body, not just the looks.
584e5ac2504a.t: Harry: Kurasa aku memahami posisinya, tapi tak mungkin aku membicarakannya tanpa menimbulkan kecurigaan. "Boleh aku tanya ceritanya tentang apa?" Severino menceritakan kisah tiga saudari itu, yang datang dan merevolusi pertanian Tolerideme dengan Energi Jiwa dan tepung ikan yang dicampur tahi manusia. Kaitannya: apa pun rupa tubuh mereka, saudari-saudari itu punya pikiran yang cemerlang dan tekad sekeras batu. Severino mendorong Harry (dan Vitor) untuk memikirkan pikiran di balik tubuh, bukan hanya penampilan.

5a7330b284ff.en: Takeo snaps back from his own finger-snapping thoughts. "I didn't taste anything weird." "Did you even ask anything?" "Why would I? People lie, but their souls don't." The captain takes his feet off the desk, pulls out a specific contract with sapphires set in its corners, and starts scribbling. "Fair point. I'm gonna give you a Sapphire-level quest."
5a7330b284ff.t: Takeo tersentak kembali dari pikirannya sendiri tentang mematahkan jari. "Aku tidak mencicipi apa pun yang aneh." "Kamu bahkan bertanya sesuatu?" "Buat apa? Orang berbohong, tapi jiwa mereka tidak." Sang kapten menurunkan kakinya dari meja, mengeluarkan kontrak khusus dengan sapphire di sudut-sudutnya, dan mulai menulis. "Masuk akal. Aku akan memberimu misi tingkat Sapphire."

5aef386ff2f7.en: Eori turns and starts climbing. Step by step, she feels herself pulling ahead of him; a good, tickly feeling hits her brain. She smiles creepily and giggles as she picks up her pace.
5aef386ff2f7.t: Eori berbalik dan mulai mendaki. Selangkah demi selangkah, ia merasa dirinya makin mendahului Kibe; perasaan geli yang menyenangkan menyerang otaknya. Ia tersenyum menyeramkan dan terkikik sambil mempercepat langkahnya.

5b61a28356a1.en: They talk about other things. Severino explains that they're splitting everyone up as assistants: "Dalila, please follow Nailah. Desmond, follow me. You over there, you follow X," and so on.
5b61a28356a1.t: Mereka membicarakan hal-hal lain. Severino menjelaskan bahwa mereka membagi semua orang menjadi asisten: "Dalila, tolong ikut Nailah. Desmond, ikut aku. Kamu yang di sana, ikut X," dan seterusnya.

5bf596341542.en: Harry asks who that is. Severino: Yosuke is an interesting character, but he micromanages everything, which makes his restaurant both popular and unpopular, since he does everything fresh. He's very particular, too: he even bought Wood People wood and brought it down to Nailah to make his plates and pickers, all because he didn't trust anyone else to do it. Harry should visit his restaurant in Forway one day.
5bf596341542.t: Harry bertanya siapa itu. Severino: Yosuke adalah tokoh yang menarik, tapi ia mengatur segalanya sampai hal terkecil, yang membuat restorannya populer sekaligus tidak populer, karena ia mengerjakan semuanya segar. Ia juga sangat rewel: ia bahkan membeli Wood People wood dan membawanya ke Nailah untuk dibuatkan piring dan picker-nya, semua karena ia tak memercayai orang lain untuk melakukannya. Harry harus mengunjungi restorannya di Forway suatu hari nanti.

5cb905fdc718.en: Dalila, Harry and the Rebula family at an emptied market, the wagon empty too; Severino hands each of them a pouch
5cb905fdc718.t: Dalila, Harry, dan keluarga Rebula di pasar yang sudah sepi, gerobaknya juga kosong; Severino memberi masing-masing sebuah kantong

5d29340413dd.en: Kibe: "You do realize I'm not paying for your food, right?" Eori's face contorts as she forces the words out. "I am a princess of Sanbi." "So?" "Can I please have some food?" "I can accept that." Kibe signals the bartender.
5d29340413dd.t: Kibe: "Kamu sadar aku tidak akan membayar makananmu, kan?" Wajah Eori berkerut saat ia memaksakan kata-katanya keluar. "Aku putri Sanbi." "Terus?" "Boleh aku minta makanan?" "Itu bisa kuterima." Kibe memberi isyarat kepada bartender.

5e493c404c1a.en: Yosuke: "SUB CHEF, WHERE'S THE BROTH?" "WARMFEEL! SMALL TIME CHUNK!" Yosuke looks proud. Dalila looks at Harry with pity. "Are you okay?" "Kinda. I guess I'm terrified of knives." Or rather, of Eori.
5e493c404c1a.t: Yosuke: "SUB-KOKI, MANA KALDUNYA?" "WARMFEEL! SMALL TIME CHUNK!" Yosuke tampak bangga. Dalila menatap Harry dengan iba. "Kamu baik-baik saja?" "Lumayan. Kurasa aku takut pisau." Atau lebih tepatnya, takut Eori.

5e906f431bbb.en: Harry takes a spoonful of soup and looks at the hanging bandits: one is passed out, another is falling asleep, and the third stares at everyone intently. Harry and the bandit lock eyes; the bandit narrows his. Harry turns back to his soup, and notices the girl on his left with tears on her face. "You okay?"
5e906f431bbb.t: Harry menyendok sup dan menatap para bandit yang tergantung: satu pingsan, satu lagi hampir tertidur, dan yang ketiga menatap semua orang dengan tajam. Harry dan bandit itu saling bertatapan; bandit itu menyipitkan mata. Harry kembali ke supnya, dan menyadari gadis di sebelah kirinya berlinang air mata. "Kamu baik-baik saja?"

62e4254afc43.en: Takeo pins Harry against the wall with his arm and snaps off his fingers
62e4254afc43.t: Takeo menekan Harry ke dinding dengan lengannya dan mematahkan jari-jarinya

6373785bbac5.en: Severino hands each of them a pouch of balls. "Thank you, Dalila and Desmond. Desmond, it's been great cutting wood with you, and Dalila, you taught us a lot today with your merchant skills." Vitor, slightly flustered: "T—thank you." Nailah: "And thank you for helping me with the wood carving."
6373785bbac5.t: Severino memberi masing-masing sekantong bola. "Terima kasih, Dalila dan Desmond. Desmond, menyenangkan menebang kayu bersamamu, dan Dalila, kamu mengajari kami banyak hari ini dengan keterampilan dagangmu." Vitor, agak gugup: "T—terima kasih." Nailah: "Dan terima kasih sudah membantuku mengukir kayu."

663b00beb4af.en: Eori didn't get a consent form for the experiment she was performing under Huneo's directive, and then she killed Huneo. At the trial, Huneo decides her punishment: swim to the base of Waterfall, then climb the Cliff Walk (Waterfall › Points of interest) (10,764 steps) without nari gels. Eori: "IMPOSSIBLE!"
663b00beb4af.t: Eori tidak mendapatkan formulir persetujuan untuk eksperimen yang ia lakukan atas arahan Huneo, lalu ia membunuh Huneo. Di pengadilan, Huneo menentukan hukumannya: berenang sampai kaki Waterfall, lalu mendaki Cliff Walk (Waterfall › Tempat menarik) (10.764 anak tangga) tanpa nari gel. Eori: "MUSTAHIL!"

66481d50380c.en: The captain takes out a clean Steen branch and starts chewing as everyone waits in silence. Takeo looks at the guards, then at the captain, who's enjoying his chew. "Are you going to issue a quest for me or not?"
66481d50380c.t: Sang kapten mengeluarkan dahan Steen yang bersih dan mulai mengunyah sementara semua orang menunggu dalam diam. Takeo menatap para penjaga, lalu sang kapten, yang sedang menikmati kunyahannya. "Anda mau memasang misi untuk saya atau tidak?"

66773237a8e9.en: Harry sees a backlog of people at the entrance. He looks at Dalila, panting from overstuffing herself. "Do we wait in line too?" "We don't have badges." Dalila heads east. Harry watches someone show his badge to a guard and walk through, then follows her.
66773237a8e9.t: Harry melihat antrean orang di pintu masuk. Ia menatap Dalila, terengah-engah karena terlalu banyak makan. "Kita juga antre?" "Kita tidak punya lencana." Dalila menuju ke timur. Harry melihat seseorang menunjukkan lencananya kepada penjaga dan berjalan masuk, lalu mengikutinya.

66e1adffba40.en: Severino: "Do you really need to take her finger off? Can't you just suck on it, like the others?" "Yes. Now give me your hand, and I'll make it quick." Severino covers his son's eyes, and Nailah looks away. Dalila holds out her hand.
66e1adffba40.t: Severino: "Apa kamu benar-benar harus mencabut jarinya? Tidak bisakah kamu mengisapnya saja, seperti yang lain?" "Harus. Sekarang berikan tanganmu, dan akan kubuat cepat." Severino menutup mata putranya, dan Nailah memalingkan wajah. Dalila mengulurkan tangannya.

67d8348c1728.en: Harry jumps on it. His scalp itches as new hair is pumped through, and the stylist cuts it short. When it's time to shave his beard, Harry's PTSD kicks in. The stylist asks what's wrong; Harry won't say. The stylist gives him Steen to relax, then cuts the beard.
67d8348c1728.t: Harry langsung menyambarnya. Kulit kepalanya gatal saat rambut baru dipompakan, dan penata rambut memotongnya pendek. Saat tiba waktunya mencukur janggut, PTSD Harry kambuh. Penata rambut bertanya ada apa; Harry tak mau bilang. Penata rambut memberinya Steen agar rileks, lalu mencukur janggutnya.

68faa29913d5.en: Eori stands up to head back to the stairs
68faa29913d5.t: Eori berdiri untuk kembali ke tangga

698d8c44b9f2.en: Yosuke asks Harry to show his skills. Harry is afraid of the knife; bad memories creep in, and he slices off a huge chunk. Yosuke: "AWFUL!" He shows Harry how it's done. "AGAIN!" Harry tries again, but he's sloppy: he's afraid of the knife, and the bad memories creep in. "GET OUT!" "Sorry, chef." Harry goes to take orders.
698d8c44b9f2.t: Yosuke meminta Harry menunjukkan keahliannya. Harry takut pada pisau; kenangan buruk merayap masuk, dan ia mengiris potongan yang besar sekali. Yosuke: "PAYAH!" Ia menunjukkan kepada Harry bagaimana caranya. "LAGI!" Harry mencoba lagi, tapi ia ceroboh: ia takut pada pisau, dan kenangan buruk merayap masuk. "KELUAR!" "Maaf, chef." Harry pergi mencatat pesanan.

6ee8887b154d.en: Eori, in a loud whisper: "What the fuck is his problem?" Kibe points at the sign behind her. Eori reads the lovely poster: "Couples who climb together, stay together." Kibe: "It's a thing for some people. Just ignore it."
6ee8887b154d.t: Eori, berbisik keras: "Apa masalah orang itu, sialan?" Kibe menunjuk papan di belakangnya. Eori membaca poster yang manis itu: "Pasangan yang mendaki bersama, tetap bersama." Kibe: "Itu tradisi bagi sebagian orang. Abaikan saja."

6f1c5788eea8.en: They bicker until Eiri walks in. After a tangent, Eiri tells them the Tolerideme family is coming to visit, and that Eori is leaving for Forway, so they need to wash all her clothes and have everything ready for when she arrives. The maids ask why. Eiri: "Neferteri decided it was best for her."
6f1c5788eea8.t: Mereka bertengkar sampai Eiri masuk. Setelah melantur sebentar, Eiri memberi tahu mereka bahwa keluarga Tolerideme akan berkunjung, dan bahwa Eori akan berangkat ke Forway, jadi mereka harus mencuci semua pakaiannya dan menyiapkan segalanya untuk saat ia tiba. Para pelayan bertanya kenapa. Eiri: "Neferteri memutuskan itu yang terbaik untuknya."

6f788745ca15.en: Harry, Dalila and Yosuke in the restaurant's attic
6f788745ca15.t: Harry, Dalila, dan Yosuke di loteng restoran

71c00d66b5cd.en: Takeo walks toward Harry, clicking his pliers. Harry, backed against the wall, can't get a word out. Takeo pushes him up the wall with one hand and takes off one of his fingers with the other. He loves the taste. Harry fights to break free, to no avail.
71c00d66b5cd.t: Takeo berjalan ke arah Harry, mengeklik tangnya. Harry, terpojok di dinding, tak bisa mengucapkan sepatah kata pun. Takeo mendorongnya naik ke dinding dengan satu tangan dan mencabut salah satu jarinya dengan tangan yang lain. Ia suka rasanya. Harry meronta untuk melepaskan diri, sia-sia.

740c8b0dec3c.en: The guards close in on Eori, and she swings her cuffed arms around. "DON'T TOUCH ME!" She walks out, back toward the castle.
740c8b0dec3c.t: Para penjaga mendekati Eori, dan ia mengayun-ayunkan lengannya yang diborgol. "JANGAN SENTUH AKU!" Ia keluar, kembali ke arah kastil.

742a906cb4bb.en: A bartender comes into the kitchen, reads off an order of mains and sides, and sticks the ticket on a hook in the wall. Yosuke: "COMING RIGHT UP! SUB CHEF, SIDES, ASAP!" "YES, CHEF!"
742a906cb4bb.t: Seorang bartender masuk ke dapur, membacakan pesanan hidangan utama dan pendamping, dan menancapkan tiketnya di kait di dinding. Yosuke: "SEGERA DATANG! SUB-KOKI, PENDAMPING, SECEPATNYA!" "SIAP, CHEF!"

74a67d8e9326.en: "Yo! Good luck!" A familiar voice. She stops, and Kibe strolls leisurely past her and keeps going. Anger builds. "WHAT THE FUCK IS YOUR PROBLEM?" Kibe turns his head. "Mine? None?"
74a67d8e9326.t: "Yo! Semoga berhasil!" Suara yang familier. Ia berhenti, dan Kibe berjalan santai melewatinya dan terus naik. Amarah memuncak. "APA MASALAHMU, SIALAN?" Kibe menoleh. "Masalahku? Tidak ada?"

77cc4b47ee9c.en: Harry looks at the Bagarisa meat; his stomach turns and something rises in his throat. He vividly sees the Bagarisa friends he once had: those days were short-lived, but carefree. "Desmond? Desmond?" Severino breaks through his scattered thoughts. "Oh, sorry. I was trying to remember some things."
77cc4b47ee9c.t: Harry menatap daging Bagarisa itu; perutnya bergolak dan sesuatu naik ke tenggorokannya. Ia melihat dengan jelas teman-teman Bagarisa yang pernah ia punya: hari-hari itu singkat, tapi tanpa beban. "Desmond? Desmond?" Severino menembus pikirannya yang berserakan. "Oh, maaf. Aku sedang berusaha mengingat beberapa hal."

78a765916e71.en: Chapter 5 - All roads lead to Forway

79e8ce55d3db.en: She thinks about killing Kibe, burying his body, then reporting that Cruros attacked him; she thinks about how she'd injure herself to back up her story.
79e8ce55d3db.t: Ia berpikir untuk membunuh Kibe, mengubur jasadnya, lalu melaporkan bahwa para Cruro menyerangnya; ia memikirkan bagaimana ia akan melukai dirinya sendiri untuk mendukung ceritanya.

7b05c83b6b07.en: Harry messes up and starts bleeding, and he doesn't heal like before. Yosuke: "DON'T BLEED OVER THE VEGETABLES!" That triggers a panic attack. Rimir, the sub chef, casts a heal, and Harry's hand closes up. Yosuke, from the other corner: "SUCK IT UP! TRY AGAIN!" Sub chef: "Wash the blood off the vegetables, or it'll change the taste." Harry carefully does as he's told.
7b05c83b6b07.t: Harry melakukan kesalahan dan mulai berdarah, dan ia tidak sembuh seperti dulu. Yosuke: "JANGAN BERDARAH DI ATAS SAYURAN!" Itu memicu serangan panik. Rimir, si sub-koki, merapal penyembuhan, dan tangan Harry menutup. Yosuke, dari sudut lain: "TAHAN! COBA LAGI!" Sub-koki: "Cuci darahnya dari sayuran, atau rasanya akan berubah." Harry dengan hati-hati melakukan apa yang disuruh.

7b1fe1226dc7.en: Nailah: "I made plenty today. Thank you, Dalila and Desmond." Severino: "It's been a great help. Tomorrow we're going to sell a lot at {VillageSouthOfForway}. On that note, Nailah?" Nailah remembers something. "By the way, {WIP-nailahMessenger} came back from Forway. Yosuke wants to hire both of you." Dalila stops eating for a second, and a big, greasy smile spreads across her face.
7b1fe1226dc7.t: Nailah: "Hari ini aku membuat banyak. Terima kasih, Dalila dan Desmond." Severino: "Itu sangat membantu. Besok kita akan menjual banyak di {VillageSouthOfForway}. Omong-omong, Nailah?" Nailah teringat sesuatu. "Ngomong-ngomong, {WIP-nailahMessenger} sudah kembali dari Forway. Yosuke ingin mempekerjakan kalian berdua." Dalila berhenti makan sejenak, dan senyum lebar berminyak merekah di wajahnya.

7b502d2a8c71.en: Neferteri adds that in Forway, Eori will have more freedom as well. Eori fights her off for being controlling, and that's how the carrot comes out.
7b502d2a8c71.t: Neferteri menambahkan bahwa di Forway, Eori juga akan punya lebih banyak kebebasan. Eori menolaknya karena ia suka mengekang, dan begitulah wortelnya keluar.

7e15946ee574.en: Eori feels the world crumbling. Without a word, she climbs out into the shallows, sits on the ground, curls up and cries her heart out. Kibe: "This seems like a lot, kinda. You sure you don't want it?"
7e15946ee574.t: Eori merasakan dunia runtuh. Tanpa sepatah kata, ia turun ke perairan dangkal, duduk di tanah, meringkuk, dan menangis sejadi-jadinya. Kibe: "Ini kelihatannya agak banyak. Kamu yakin tidak mau?"

80ff57c4c6c9.en: Takeo: "I get the whole picture now. This Hifuna beast in Bagarisa form attacked your wagon, then went to the Black Magina farm, where it exploded. Hold out your hand." He takes out pliers, already blood-stained. Dalila looks unsure.
80ff57c4c6c9.t: Takeo: "Sekarang aku paham gambaran utuhnya. Makhluk buas Hifuna berwujud Bagarisa ini menyerang gerobakmu, lalu pergi ke ladang Black Magina, tempat ia meledak. Ulurkan tanganmu." Ia mengeluarkan tang, sudah bernoda darah. Dalila tampak ragu.

82b252a3a5e9.en: Vitor looks at Dalila with worry: she's barely breathing as she shovels food into her face. Maybe she isn't even tasting it, like a dog gulping down food without chewing. He wants to say something, looks at his father, and his father shakes his head. Vitor looks down.
82b252a3a5e9.t: Vitor menatap Dalila dengan cemas: ia nyaris tak bernapas sambil menjejalkan makanan ke mulutnya. Mungkin ia bahkan tidak merasakannya, seperti anjing yang menelan makanan tanpa mengunyah. Ia ingin mengatakan sesuatu, menatap ayahnya, dan ayahnya menggeleng. Vitor menunduk.

865e4616715b.en: With a loud crunch, Takeo tosses the thumb in the air and catches it in his mouth, like popcorn. He sits on the bed, wipes the pliers on the sheets and puts them away. "So that's the taste of a pure Naked Brunto. No wonder the Lishies slurped you people up."
865e4616715b.t: Dengan bunyi kriuk yang keras, Takeo melempar ibu jari itu ke udara dan menangkapnya dengan mulut, seperti popcorn. Ia duduk di kasur, mengelap tang di seprai dan menyimpannya. "Jadi itu rasanya Naked Brunto murni. Pantas para Lishies menyeruput kalian."

879e36ffc2aa.en: Eori and Neferteri at the top of the stairs
879e36ffc2aa.t: Eori dan Neferteri di puncak tangga

88f9b56b5e48.en: The guards all look surprised, and Takeo looks pretty interested too. "What am I supposed to do?" The captain keeps writing as if he hadn't heard. A guard leans over and whispers: "He doesn't answer until he finishes whatever he's doing."
88f9b56b5e48.t: Para penjaga semua tampak terkejut, dan Takeo juga tampak cukup tertarik. "Apa yang harus saya lakukan?" Sang kapten terus menulis seolah tidak mendengar. Seorang penjaga mencondongkan badan dan berbisik: "Dia tidak menjawab sampai selesai dengan apa pun yang sedang dia kerjakan."

8b2cdb4f0f0d.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Who the fuck are you? What are you doing to us?" Takeo locks the door. "Let's talk." He looks at the clicking steel pliers and goes to hit him, but he's too weak: Takeo punches him aside, and he hits the wall and falls to the floor, his head bleeding. {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} hesitates to strike back, but Takeo lands a blow to his face that sends him flying toward Harry.
8b2cdb4f0f0d.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit}: "Kamu ini siapa, sialan? Apa yang kamu lakukan pada kami?" Takeo mengunci pintu. "Ayo bicara." Pria itu menatap tang baja yang berbunyi klik dan hendak memukulnya, tapi ia terlalu lemah: Takeo meninjunya ke samping, dan ia menghantam dinding lalu jatuh ke lantai, kepalanya berdarah. {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} ragu untuk membalas, tapi Takeo melayangkan pukulan ke wajahnya yang membuatnya terpental ke arah Harry.

8c6499beee4d.en: Sub chef: "You noticed it too?" Dalila looks at him with concern. "Do you know why?" "I asked, but he said he didn't know—" Yosuke slaps the table. "WE'RE IN THE KITCHEN! I'M NOT GONNA SAY IT AGAIN!" "YES, CHEF! SORRY, CHEF!" the sub chef and Dalila say in unison.
8c6499beee4d.t: Sub-koki: "Kamu juga memperhatikannya?" Dalila menatapnya dengan cemas. "Kamu tahu kenapa?" "Aku sudah tanya, tapi dia bilang dia tidak tahu—" Yosuke menggebrak meja. "KITA SEDANG DI DAPUR! AKU TIDAK AKAN BILANG LAGI!" "SIAP, CHEF! MAAF, CHEF!" kata si sub-koki dan Dalila serempak.

8ed682fe9d98.en: The guards let them go. Adventurer: "Why did you lie?" Ryo: "Of course I would. The Red Winga is bigger than you think."
8ed682fe9d98.t: Para penjaga membiarkan mereka pergi. Petualang: "Kenapa kamu berbohong?" Ryo: "Tentu saja. Red Winga lebih besar dari yang kamu kira."

8f2cfb4fa669.en: With a loud snap, Harry's thumb flies off. "Shit." Takeo lets go of Harry and goes looking for it. Propped against the wall, Harry's knees give out; he falls to the floor, shielding his chopped-up hand as blood keeps pouring out.
8f2cfb4fa669.t: Dengan bunyi patah yang keras, ibu jari Harry terlempar. "Sial." Takeo melepaskan Harry dan pergi mencarinya. Bersandar di dinding, lutut Harry menyerah; ia jatuh ke lantai, melindungi tangannya yang tercincang saat darah terus mengucur.

904feb15811c.en: A day in, Eori is cold and hungry while Kibe enjoys a nice dinner
904feb15811c.t: Sehari kemudian, Eori kedinginan dan kelaparan sementara Kibe menikmati makan malam yang enak

9174697b7d4c.en: Her steps are slow, but steady. Eight hundred and twenty-four—eight hundred and twenty-five—eight hundred and twenty-six. Her mind is set on finishing this trial, nothing more, nothing less. Nothing could possibly shake her focus—
9174697b7d4c.t: Langkahnya lambat, tapi mantap. Delapan ratus dua puluh empat—delapan ratus dua puluh lima—delapan ratus dua puluh enam. Pikirannya tertuju pada menuntaskan cobaan ini, tidak lebih, tidak kurang. Tak ada yang mungkin bisa menggoyahkan fokusnya—

92cadf7c2047.en: Panic races through Harry's heart. He looks at his hands and feels a sense of power overwhelming him. In one swift move, he's out of bed and tumbling to the back of the room, putting distance between himself and this monstrous figure. Takeo smiles and clicks his pliers, and the room goes silent.
92cadf7c2047.t: Panik berpacu di hati Harry. Ia menatap tangannya dan merasakan kekuatan yang membanjirinya. Dalam satu gerakan cepat, ia sudah keluar dari kasur dan terguling ke belakang ruangan, menjaga jarak antara dirinya dan sosok mengerikan ini. Takeo tersenyum dan mengeklik tangnya, dan ruangan menjadi hening.

93243bb1be12.en: Ryo sits down with the sisters, still in Sayna form. "All right, I need you two to pay attention. I'm gonna go get in touch with my Red Winga contact. Hide in the ceiling or somewhere else, and if anyone enters this room, make a mental note of their face, especially any symbols they wear. Understood?" The Saynas bob their cute little heads. He pats them both. "Especially you, Katsumi. Don't do anything rash." He leaves.
93243bb1be12.t: Ryo duduk bersama kedua saudari itu, masih dalam wujud Sayna. "Baiklah, aku butuh kalian berdua memperhatikan. Aku akan menghubungi kontak Red Winga-ku. Bersembunyilah di langit-langit atau di tempat lain, dan kalau ada yang masuk ke kamar ini, ingat wajahnya, terutama lambang apa pun yang mereka pakai. Mengerti?" Kedua Sayna mengangguk-anggukkan kepala kecil mereka yang imut. Ia mengelus keduanya. "Terutama kamu, Katsumi. Jangan berbuat gegabah." Ia pergi.

93aa4188cd87.en: Severino walks over to Harry. "Do you know who you are?" Harry feels awkward answering; he wonders if they'll send him back to Eori. He shakes his head. Takeo threatens him, but Harry holds firm. Takeo: "All right. You two have a lovely chat. I'm gonna go hand in these two bandits."
93aa4188cd87.t: Severino berjalan menghampiri Harry. "Kamu tahu siapa dirimu?" Harry merasa canggung menjawab; ia bertanya-tanya apakah mereka akan mengirimnya kembali ke Eori. Ia menggeleng. Takeo mengancamnya, tapi Harry bertahan. Takeo: "Baiklah. Kalian berdua mengobrol yang menyenangkan. Aku mau menyerahkan dua bandit ini."

94df899e5fe8.en: Aurora: "Why is Eiri so down lately?" Sora explains that Huneo won't fund Harry's search quest. Itanema: "Why don't we hold a burial for Harry and put an end to it?" Sora: "I'm not telling her that!"
94df899e5fe8.t: Aurora: "Kenapa Eiri murung belakangan ini?" Sora menjelaskan bahwa Huneo tidak mau mendanai misi pencarian Harry. Itanema: "Kenapa tidak kita adakan pemakaman untuk Harry dan mengakhirinya?" Sora: "Aku tidak mau bilang itu kepadanya!"

9839d6927796.en: The guards ask if they saw anything weird in the forest, or talked with anyone who did. Ryo: "We saw tons of broken carts on the road with nobody in sight, so we fled toward Forway." "Did you see the explosion?" "We heard a rumble in the sky, but apparently we were too far south of it. We fled to Deltacross." The captain asks if they're looking for family members. Ryo: "No, just passing through, on my way back home to Flatland." The adventurer holds back and keeps up the lie. (Forway, then Deltacross: Ryo's story slips, because it's all a lie for the guards.)
9839d6927796.t: Para penjaga bertanya apakah mereka melihat sesuatu yang aneh di hutan, atau berbicara dengan seseorang yang melihatnya. Ryo: "Kami melihat banyak sekali gerobak rusak di jalan tanpa seorang pun terlihat, jadi kami kabur ke arah Forway." "Kalian melihat ledakannya?" "Kami mendengar gemuruh di langit, tapi rupanya kami terlalu jauh di selatannya. Kami kabur ke Deltacross." Sang kapten bertanya apakah mereka mencari anggota keluarga. Ryo: "Tidak, hanya lewat, dalam perjalanan pulang ke Flatland." Si petualang menahan diri dan ikut berbohong. (Forway, lalu Deltacross: cerita Ryo tergelincir, karena semuanya bohong untuk para penjaga.)

99182d961248.en: Vitor breaks through his shyness, walks up to Dalila and pats her head. Dalila, eyes red, sniffles as she looks at the flushed boy staring at her.
99182d961248.t: Vitor menembus rasa malunya, menghampiri Dalila dan menepuk kepalanya. Dalila, matanya merah, terisak sambil menatap bocah yang wajahnya memerah itu.

9b6b9542c32f.en: Takeo snaps off her ring finger and pops it in his mouth, savoring it like a French person savors wine, rolling the chewed finger from one side of his tongue to the other. "Mostly Tolerideme, with some Wozefaries. You're good." Dalila tears up as her finger grows back. Takeo heads for the door. "I'm gonna check a few more."
9b6b9542c32f.t: Takeo mematahkan jari manisnya dan memasukkannya ke mulut, menikmatinya seperti orang Prancis menikmati anggur, menggulirkan jari yang dikunyah dari satu sisi lidah ke sisi lainnya. "Kebanyakan Tolerideme, dengan sedikit Wozefaries. Kamu aman." Dalila menitikkan air mata saat jarinya tumbuh kembali. Takeo menuju pintu. "Aku akan memeriksa beberapa lagi."

9fca3cad0c72.en: Everything itches. Harry realizes this is his chance to put Harry behind him and start anew. He needs money to change his appearance, and then he'll be all good.
9fca3cad0c72.t: Semuanya gatal. Harry sadar inilah kesempatannya untuk meninggalkan Harry di belakang dan memulai lembaran baru. Ia butuh uang untuk mengubah penampilannya, dan setelah itu semuanya akan beres.

a02fe8dff969.en: The captain savors his Steen a bit longer before spitting into a nearby bucket. "How did the biopsy go?" Guard: "It's a big, strong, alpha Bagarisa, but it's just a Bagarisa."
a02fe8dff969.t: Sang kapten menikmati Steen-nya sedikit lebih lama sebelum meludah ke ember di dekatnya. "Bagaimana hasil biopsinya?" Penjaga: "Itu Bagarisa alfa yang besar dan kuat, tapi hanya seekor Bagarisa."

a1687c729c5d.en: With some of her energy back, Eori stands, prepares her speech, and releases it in one pent-up breath. "Thank you!" She turns toward the stairs, and with a quick glance sees Kibe planted in his chair, gazing at the horizon, letting time go to waste. "Why aren't you coming?" "Why would I? I can climb those stairs tomorrow, or later. Huneo's gonna bitch either way."
a1687c729c5d.t: Dengan sebagian tenaganya pulih, Eori berdiri, menyiapkan kata-katanya, dan melepaskannya dalam satu napas yang tertahan. "Terima kasih!" Ia berbalik ke arah tangga, dan dengan lirikan cepat melihat Kibe tertancap di kursinya, menatap cakrawala, membiarkan waktu terbuang. "Kenapa kamu tidak ikut?" "Buat apa? Aku bisa mendaki tangga itu besok, atau nanti. Huneo akan menggerutu bagaimanapun."

a1dc4424080f.en: Harry is tense because of Takeo. July is being playful; Takeo doesn't give a shit. Harry goes to fetch beer, wondering whether they've found out who he truly is. He sets the beer on the table, and July grabs him by the shirt, slips him a note and winks.
a1dc4424080f.t: Harry tegang karena Takeo. July sedang genit; Takeo sama sekali tak peduli. Harry pergi mengambil bir, bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sudah tahu siapa dirinya sebenarnya. Ia menaruh bir di meja, dan July mencengkeram bajunya, menyelipkan secarik catatan, dan mengedipkan mata.

a284688491f1.en: Yosuke flicks open a knife, like the one Eori used to perforate Harry's neck. Harry jumps back, protecting his throat, his heart pounding as he breaks into a sweat. "If you don't cut that beard, I will." Dalila: "Did you just remember something?" Harry shakes his head. "I'm sorry, it's just that I—don't know. It felt weird."
a284688491f1.t: Yosuke membuka pisau lipat, seperti yang dipakai Eori untuk melubangi leher Harry. Harry melompat mundur, melindungi tenggorokannya, jantungnya berdebar kencang saat keringatnya mengucur. "Kalau kamu tidak mencukur janggut itu, aku yang akan mencukurnya." Dalila: "Kamu baru teringat sesuatu?" Harry menggeleng. "Maaf, cuma saja aku—tidak tahu. Rasanya aneh."

a9d1f2689214.en: Yosuke brings them inside and upstairs to show them the attic. They have a timehunk to bathe and get ready, hair tied up included. He explains their tight schedule; Rimir, the sub chef, lives in the top-right bunk bed.
a9d1f2689214.t: Yosuke membawa mereka masuk dan naik untuk menunjukkan loteng. Mereka punya satu timehunk untuk mandi dan bersiap, termasuk mengikat rambut. Ia menjelaskan jadwal mereka yang padat; Rimir, si sub-koki, tinggal di tempat tidur tingkat kanan atas.

ac23579e3c9a.en: Yosuke sets the blade aside, grabs a Time Counter and sets it to a Quarter Time Chunk. "No excuses. Desmond, you're going to the barber." He gives directions and leaves: Harry has until Sunnihigh. Harry looks at Dalila, who points out the window. "Look at that intersection. See the sign? Follow it." She grabs her clothes and heads to the bathroom. Harry looks outside again. Here we go.
ac23579e3c9a.t: Yosuke menaruh bilahnya, meraih Time Counter dan menyetelnya ke Quarter Time Chunk. "Tidak ada alasan. Desmond, kamu ke tukang cukur." Ia memberi petunjuk arah lalu pergi: Harry punya waktu sampai Sunnihigh. Harry menatap Dalila, yang menunjuk ke luar jendela. "Lihat persimpangan itu. Lihat papannya? Ikuti." Ia mengambil pakaiannya dan menuju kamar mandi. Harry melihat ke luar lagi. Ayo mulai.

ac3e076a1ec4.en: Takeo lets out a big yawn, and the others follow suit. They chat about the world and random stuff.
ac3e076a1ec4.t: Takeo menguap lebar, dan yang lain ikut menguap. Mereka mengobrol tentang dunia dan hal-hal acak.

accaf51998fe.en: Harry #14 and Dalila help Yosuke in the kitchen
accaf51998fe.t: Harry #14 dan Dalila membantu Yosuke di dapur

ad6166513902.en: Harry #13 and Severino, ready to cut down trees
ad6166513902.t: Harry #13 dan Severino, siap menebang pohon

ae247277072b.en: The guards talk about how cute the Saynas are: one is very playful, the other very quiet. Ryo says a friend of his is getting into breeding them, and he got first dibs.
ae247277072b.t: Para penjaga membicarakan betapa imutnya Sayna-Sayna itu: satu sangat suka bermain, yang lain sangat pendiam. Ryo bilang seorang temannya sedang mulai membiakkan mereka, dan ia mendapat hak pilih pertama.

af6ed0c09849.en: Harry nods and slides his plate over. She stabs her picker into the meat, and Harry feels a stab in his heart, as if it were his own flesh. Vitor gets pissed off and does the same, and now Dalila has a stack of Bagarisa to eat, which brings a slight smile to her face. Harry looks at her smile. I'm sorry.
af6ed0c09849.t: Harry mengangguk dan menggeser piringnya. Dalila menusukkan picker-nya ke daging itu, dan Harry merasakan tusukan di hatinya, seolah itu dagingnya sendiri. Vitor kesal dan melakukan hal yang sama, dan kini Dalila punya setumpuk Bagarisa untuk dimakan, yang memunculkan senyum tipis di wajahnya. Harry menatap senyumnya. Maafkan aku.

b10431e80f69.en: The door opens and shuts just as loudly. Harry sits in bed, trying to place all these familiar faces and places; everything is hazy, because his vision is shit.
b10431e80f69.t: Pintu terbuka dan tertutup sama kerasnya. Harry duduk di kasur, berusaha mengenali semua wajah dan tempat yang familier ini; semuanya buram, karena penglihatannya payah.

b553522ceffd.en: He comes over. "Princess Eori. You have a lovely partner. Ready to order?" Eori feels a vein pop in her head; she swallows her pride in one big gulp, to avoid making a mess, and orders a feast. Kibe, not giving a shit, orders his own. The bartender gives them the total in Pearls and goes to get the juice.
b553522ceffd.t: Ia menghampiri. "Putri Eori. Pasangan Anda menawan. Siap memesan?" Eori merasakan urat di kepalanya berdenyut; ia menelan harga dirinya dalam satu tegukan besar, agar tidak membuat keributan, dan memesan jamuan besar. Kibe, sama sekali tak peduli, memesan untuk dirinya sendiri. Bartender menyebutkan totalnya dalam Pearl dan pergi mengambil jusnya.

b573ecdf0e01.en: Harry says he had no idea it took so long to trim all the branches. Severino: that's not even the most time-consuming part. Sculpting is.
b573ecdf0e01.t: Harry bilang ia tak tahu memangkas semua dahan memakan waktu selama itu. Severino: itu bahkan bukan bagian yang paling lama. Mengukir yang paling lama.

b582fba90725.en: Harry at the hair salon, where white hair is in fashion right now, and cheap
b582fba90725.t: Harry di salon rambut, tempat rambut putih sedang tren saat ini, dan murah

b6591536a31d.en: Harry looks at the note while the two bartenders, Hanako and Mimi, poke fun at him
b6591536a31d.t: Harry melihat catatan itu sementara kedua bartender, Hanako dan Mimi, mengolok-oloknya

b88f5536398c.en: I saved her, and she still won't say a word? Fine! Have it your way! The rebel Sayna turns and heads for the other corner of the room.
b88f5536398c.t: Aku menyelamatkannya, dan dia tetap tidak mau bicara sepatah kata pun? Baiklah! Terserah kamu! Sayna pemberontak itu berbalik dan menuju sudut lain ruangan.

b8d261cf831c.en: The adventurer holds the Sayna up and looks it in the eyes. "My point is, you two are Red Winga property! You signed the contract, so now the Forway guards can come hunting you down!" Ryo: "Not for long. I have my connections." "Leave me out of it. The last thing I want is trouble at the embassy." "A promise is a promise. Our contract ends as soon as we set foot in Forway." "Is that a whole battalion of Forway guards?" "You'd better believe it…"
b8d261cf831c.t: Si petualang mengangkat Sayna itu dan menatap matanya. "Maksudku, kalian berdua milik Red Winga! Kalian menandatangani kontraknya, jadi sekarang penjaga Forway bisa memburu kalian!" Ryo: "Tidak lama lagi. Aku punya koneksi." "Jangan libatkan aku. Hal terakhir yang kuinginkan adalah masalah di kedutaan." "Janji adalah janji. Kontrak kita berakhir begitu kita menginjakkan kaki di Forway." "Itu satu batalion penuh penjaga Forway?" "Percayalah…"

bf26c6f536ef.en: He teaches them. Dalila goes to eat something, and the sub chef puts his hand over it. "We only eat after everyone else has had their fill." Dalila sulks.
bf26c6f536ef.t: Ia mengajari mereka. Dalila hendak memakan sesuatu, dan si sub-koki menutupinya dengan tangan. "Kita baru makan setelah semua orang kenyang." Dalila merajuk.

bff20eac9f25.en: Dalila and Harry on the wagon to Forway, Magi sitting next to Harry, holding her backpack and arrows
bff20eac9f25.t: Dalila dan Harry di gerobak menuju Forway, Magi duduk di samping Harry, memegang ransel dan anak panahnya

c24584e24668.en: Harry is about to take a spoonful when he realizes he's part of this conversation too, and looks at Nailah curiously. "I mentioned Desmond as well. It'll be a nice change of pace for both of you." Severino: "You did mention you've never been to Forway." Harry smiles. "Thanks!"
c24584e24668.t: Harry hendak menyendok saat ia sadar ia juga bagian dari percakapan ini, dan menatap Nailah dengan penasaran. "Aku juga menyebut Desmond. Ini akan jadi suasana baru yang menyenangkan bagi kalian berdua." Severino: "Kamu memang bilang belum pernah ke Forway." Harry tersenyum. "Terima kasih!"

c2c62835d772.en: Severino: "Let me guess. You wanted to ask why Dalila eats so much?" Vitor fiddles with his thumbs, silently agreeing. "She's from Broken-Tree. Didn't I already tell you the story of the three sisters?" "I know—but she's not cute anymore." Severino and Harry laugh out loud, and Vitor punches Harry in the stomach. "This is serious!" Severino: "I know plenty of Tolerideme boys—maybe even Gandew boys—who'd go crazy for her." Vitor looks down.
c2c62835d772.t: Severino: "Biar kutebak. Kamu mau tanya kenapa Dalila makan begitu banyak?" Vitor memainkan jempolnya, diam-diam membenarkan. "Dia dari Broken-Tree. Bukankah Ayah sudah menceritakan kisah tiga saudari itu?" "Aku tahu—tapi dia tidak imut lagi." Severino dan Harry tertawa keras, dan Vitor meninju perut Harry. "Ini serius!" Severino: "Ayah kenal banyak anak laki-laki Tolerideme—mungkin bahkan anak laki-laki Gandew—yang akan tergila-gila padanya." Vitor menunduk.

c37dc9851b0d.en: Eori paddles on as exhaustion sets in
c37dc9851b0d.t: Eori terus mendayung saat kelelahan mulai menyerang

c7b7d256a04c.en: Eori's fists are ready to fly at the man coming back with their juices. She imagines all the incidents she could cause to vent her anger, but in the end she stays still. She sips her juice with her eyes closed, savoring the delicious fruity flavor, while Kibe sips his and gazes at the ceiling of clouds in the distance and the faraway lands below.
c7b7d256a04c.t: Tinju Eori siap melayang ke pria yang kembali membawa jus mereka. Ia membayangkan segala keributan yang bisa ia timbulkan untuk melampiaskan amarahnya, tapi akhirnya ia tetap diam. Ia menyesap jusnya dengan mata terpejam, menikmati rasa buahnya yang lezat, sementara Kibe menyesap jusnya dan menatap langit-langit awan di kejauhan dan negeri-negeri jauh di bawah.

ce4bc5445409.en: Harry looks over at the people around the next fires: some seem to be rejoicing, others stewing in their own thoughts. He turns to Severino as guilt churns his stomach. Dalila shuts down and starts to cry; the boy hugs her and looks at Harry with murder in his eyes. "I'm sorry?" Harry swallows his guilt. He doesn't know what happened, but it's all he can say.
ce4bc5445409.t: Harry menoleh ke orang-orang di sekitar api unggun berikutnya: sebagian tampak bergembira, yang lain larut dalam pikiran mereka sendiri. Ia berbalik ke Severino saat rasa bersalah mengaduk-aduk perutnya. Dalila menutup diri dan mulai menangis; bocah itu memeluknya dan menatap Harry dengan sorot membunuh. "Maaf?" Harry menelan rasa bersalahnya. Ia tak tahu apa yang terjadi, tapi hanya itu yang bisa ia katakan.

cf9653a2dec0.en: They come across a broken wagon, broken armor and ragged clothes, with no discernible meat left. One of the men walks a little way into the forest and feels something watery hit his hand. He raises his fost lamp, and another droplet hits him right in the face: a dead girl lies in the tree branches.
cf9653a2dec0.t: Mereka menemukan gerobak rusak, zirah rusak, dan pakaian compang-camping, tanpa sisa daging yang terlihat. Salah satu pria berjalan sedikit ke dalam hutan dan merasakan sesuatu yang basah menetes ke tangannya. Ia mengangkat lampu fost-nya, dan tetesan lain jatuh tepat di wajahnya: seorang gadis yang mati tergeletak di dahan pohon.

d153d0f57b72.en: Neferteri: "Huneo, who will oversee the punishment?" "Kibe." Kibe points at himself. "Why me? Just send a guard!" "I trust you to carry out the proper punishment, and to do the Cliff Walk with her." "She's the one on trial!" "And you've been lazier than I'd hoped, so I want this to help shape you both up."
d153d0f57b72.t: Neferteri: "Huneo, siapa yang akan mengawasi hukumannya?" "Kibe." Kibe menunjuk dirinya sendiri. "Kenapa aku? Kirim saja penjaga!" "Saya memercayai Anda untuk melaksanakan hukuman yang semestinya, dan mendaki Cliff Walk bersamanya." "Dia yang diadili!" "Dan Anda lebih malas dari yang saya harapkan, jadi saya ingin ini membantu membentuk kalian berdua."

d175b6cd2600.en: Takeo lays out his Hifuna beast theory, and people sound scared. Harry wants to know more, but doesn't want the spotlight. Someone else asks the burning question: why would one come this far south? Takeo: "That's the real question. I'll present the evidence to the Forway guards and let them issue a quest for me, since none of you tasted weird." Many people shuffle their hands around, dreading the pain of losing their fingers again.
d175b6cd2600.t: Takeo memaparkan teorinya tentang makhluk buas Hifuna, dan orang-orang terdengar ketakutan. Harry ingin tahu lebih banyak, tapi tidak mau jadi pusat perhatian. Orang lain menanyakan pertanyaan yang membara: kenapa makhluk itu datang sejauh ini ke selatan? Takeo: "Itulah pertanyaan sebenarnya. Aku akan menyerahkan buktinya kepada penjaga Forway dan membiarkan mereka memasang misi untukku, karena tak satu pun dari kalian terasa aneh." Banyak orang menggerak-gerakkan tangan mereka, ngeri membayangkan sakitnya kehilangan jari lagi.

d1c6e702b1f1.en: Kibe chills in the background while Eori paddles. Her emotions, on top of the exhaustion, start exploding inside her; tears come and she throws a fit. Kibe: "Shall I give you supper?"
d1c6e702b1f1.t: Kibe bersantai di latar belakang sementara Eori mendayung. Emosinya, ditambah kelelahan, mulai meledak di dalam dirinya; air mata datang dan ia mengamuk. Kibe: "Mau kuberi makan malam?"

d337093aa740.en: Harry watches the trees go by, then the people around him: all kinds share the wagon. I'm one of them now! He smiles at the passing trees, then his smile fades. I need to change my appearance before they find me.
d337093aa740.t: Harry menatap pepohonan yang berlalu, lalu orang-orang di sekitarnya: segala macam orang berbagi gerobak itu. Aku salah satu dari mereka sekarang! Ia tersenyum pada pepohonan yang berlalu, lalu senyumnya memudar. Aku harus mengubah penampilanku sebelum mereka menemukanku.

d3589525e1ab.en: Dalila looks at Yosuke. "Do you know why he's so afraid of knives?" Yosuke: "WE'RE IN THE KITCHEN!—Those desserts, in a small timehunk! C'mon!" He claps. "YES, CHEF!" Dalila runs to the dessert station, where Rimir is working.
d3589525e1ab.t: Dalila menatap Yosuke. "Anda tahu kenapa dia begitu takut pisau?" Yosuke: "KITA SEDANG DI DAPUR!—Hidangan penutup itu, dalam satu small timehunk! Ayo!" Ia bertepuk tangan. "SIAP, CHEF!" Dalila berlari ke stasiun hidangan penutup, tempat Rimir bekerja.

d3ed68962779.en: The girl, Dalila, nods, and a boy sitting nearby squeezes between them and gives Harry a threatening look. Harry focuses back on his soup. "That's my son, Vitor," Severino says from across the fire. Harry looks at the son, then the father: aside from the age gap, they look nearly identical. He smiles nervously.
d3ed68962779.t: Gadis itu, Dalila, mengangguk, dan seorang bocah yang duduk di dekatnya menyelip di antara mereka dan menatap Harry dengan mengancam. Harry kembali fokus ke supnya. "Itu putraku, Vitor," kata Severino dari seberang api. Harry menatap sang putra, lalu sang ayah: selain selisih usia, mereka nyaris identik. Ia tersenyum gugup.

d4618cc095fa.en: Harry sits up in bed, looking at the door; Takeo has steel pliers ready
d4618cc095fa.t: Harry duduk di kasur, menatap pintu; Takeo menyiapkan tang baja

d5d7a2b1990b.en: "That's okay. You haven't touched the Bagarisa. Don't like the gaminess?" Harry puts on a fake smile and goes to cut it, but sees one of his Bagarisa friends being cut open. He sets down his fork as his stomach turns. "I'm sorry. I can't eat it." "That's okay. I can picture why."
d5d7a2b1990b.t: "Tidak apa-apa. Kamu belum menyentuh Bagarisa-nya. Tidak suka bau liarnya?" Harry memasang senyum palsu dan hendak memotongnya, tapi melihat salah satu teman Bagarisa-nya dibelah. Ia menaruh garpunya saat perutnya bergolak. "Maaf. Aku tidak bisa memakannya." "Tidak apa-apa. Aku bisa membayangkan kenapa."

d5dfcd622553.en: Chapter 1 - The past is the past.
d5dfcd622553.t: Bab 1 - Masa lalu adalah masa lalu.

d63c448628c5.en: Severino comes in and clears his throat. "Have you found the person?" Takeo: "No, but I found a purebred Naked Brunto." "What's that?" "Human? Yeah. One of you who never mixed blood with Darfaries or Wozefaries." "That's a thing?" "It's pretty rare. First time I've tasted one."
d63c448628c5.t: Severino masuk dan berdeham. "Kamu sudah menemukan orangnya?" Takeo: "Belum, tapi aku menemukan Naked Brunto berdarah murni." "Apa itu?" "Manusia? Ya. Salah satu dari kalian yang tak pernah bercampur darah dengan Darfaries atau Wozefaries." "Memang ada yang begitu?" "Cukup langka. Pertama kali aku mencicipinya."

d743e3a11819.en: Harry asks how they make money from it. It depends: usually you sculpt everyday things and sell them every week or so at a market in a nearby, larger village, or, in his wife's case, some clients come to her directly, like Yosuke.
d743e3a11819.t: Harry bertanya bagaimana mereka menghasilkan uang darinya. Tergantung: biasanya kamu mengukir barang-barang sehari-hari dan menjualnya kira-kira seminggu sekali di pasar di desa yang lebih besar di dekat situ, atau, dalam kasus istrinya, sebagian klien datang langsung kepadanya, seperti Yosuke.

d86a0c7af0ba.en: Harry: "I hope I can at least match his skill." "No worries. He's still learning too." Harry enjoys this father-son kind of bonding.
d86a0c7af0ba.t: Harry: "Kuharap setidaknya aku bisa menyamai keahliannya." "Tidak usah khawatir. Dia juga masih belajar." Harry menikmati keakraban seperti ayah dan anak ini.

db01dbe5ad31.en: For the first time, Dalila's eyes sparkle with life. She gulps down her food, her mood lifting a little. "Are you serious?" "Of course. He's one of our favorite clients." Nailah: "I'll ask {WIP-nailahMessenger} to carry a message to Yosuke before she sets off."
db01dbe5ad31.t: Untuk pertama kalinya, mata Dalila berbinar hidup. Ia menelan makanannya, suasana hatinya sedikit membaik. "Serius?" "Tentu. Dia salah satu klien favorit kami." Nailah: "Akan kuminta {WIP-nailahMessenger} membawa pesan untuk Yosuke sebelum dia berangkat."

ded592db2a82.en: She sees Harry's face. She wants to see him again, she wants to dominate him again, but how can she, now that she no longer has her mother's protection?
ded592db2a82.t: Ia melihat wajah Harry. Ia ingin bertemu dengannya lagi, ia ingin menguasainya lagi, tapi bagaimana bisa, sekarang setelah ia tak lagi punya perlindungan ibunya?

df03a6d9be5f.en: "Where are your parents? Don't you miss them?" "I don't have any," Harry says truthfully. "Then how were you born?" Harry remembers waking up in Sanbi Castle. "I have no idea—maybe I do have some, but I lost my memories of them—" Then he remembers how peaceful life in Rebula was. "—for all it matters, these past weeks felt like I was finally part of a family."
df03a6d9be5f.t: "Di mana orang tuamu? Kamu tidak merindukan mereka?" "Aku tidak punya," kata Harry jujur. "Lalu bagaimana kamu lahir?" Harry teringat terbangun di Kastil Sanbi. "Aku tidak tahu—mungkin aku punya, tapi aku kehilangan ingatanku tentang mereka—" Lalu ia teringat betapa damainya hidup di Rebula. "—bagaimanapun, beberapa minggu terakhir ini rasanya seperti akhirnya aku jadi bagian dari sebuah keluarga."

dfa28411ed07.en: Dalila, with Nailah seated beside her, Severino, Vitor (timid, and really likes Dalila) and Takeo
dfa28411ed07.t: Dalila, dengan Nailah duduk di sampingnya, Severino, Vitor (pemalu, dan sangat menyukai Dalila), dan Takeo

e00459c6e9f8.en: Kibe offers Eori food; she throws it aside. "Fine. Go hungry, then. Not like I care." Eori is sad, and angry, and the anger fuels her strength and determination: she'll conquer this and rise above Huneo. She starts thinking of ways to get rid of him, and falls asleep.
e00459c6e9f8.t: Kibe menawari Eori makanan; ia melemparnya ke samping. "Baiklah. Kelaparan saja kalau begitu. Bukan berarti aku peduli." Eori sedih, dan marah, dan amarah itu menjadi bahan bakar kekuatan dan tekadnya: ia akan menaklukkan ini dan mengungguli Huneo. Ia mulai memikirkan cara menyingkirkannya, dan tertidur.

e0d104c55858.en: Harry #13 and Severino head back, carrying wood
e0d104c55858.t: Harry #13 dan Severino pulang, mengangkut kayu

e1241a2187a7.en: Harry #13 sits by Dalila as a crowd gets ready to eat, everyone watching Takeo and Severino
e1241a2187a7.t: Harry #13 duduk di samping Dalila saat kerumunan bersiap makan, semua orang memperhatikan Takeo dan Severino

e2d72d6b4a33.en: Dalila eats viciously; Harry and everyone else eat too
e2d72d6b4a33.t: Dalila makan dengan rakus; Harry dan semua orang juga makan

e3c6b6e8e786.en: A brief silence. A guard raises his hand, and the captain nods for him to speak. "Captain, could it be that we need more adventurers hunting by the Lukewarm Lake?" The captain carefully considers it. "Takeo? Any insights?"
e3c6b6e8e786.t: Hening sejenak. Seorang penjaga mengangkat tangan, dan sang kapten mengangguk agar ia bicara. "Kapten, mungkinkah kita butuh lebih banyak petualang yang berburu di dekat Lukewarm Lake?" Sang kapten menimbangnya dengan cermat. "Takeo? Ada wawasan?"

e52fecee532b.en: Takeo looks back at Harry. "Want to go first or last?" "La—last?" Takeo sets the pliers on {WIP-katsumiBandit}'s fingers. He clips them slowly, savoring the bones breaking, as the man screams in agony. He eats the finger, shakes his head, and spits the half-chewed finger back in the bandit's face.
e52fecee532b.t: Takeo menoleh ke Harry lagi. "Mau duluan atau terakhir?" "Te—terakhir?" Takeo memasang tang di jari-jari {WIP-katsumiBandit}. Ia menjepitnya perlahan, menikmati tulang-tulang yang patah, saat pria itu menjerit kesakitan. Ia memakan jari itu, menggeleng, dan meludahkan jari yang setengah dikunyah kembali ke wajah si bandit.

e6ef23712daa.en: Harry tries to break the ice. "Forway sure is big." Dalila ignores him. A bit flustered, he keeps going: "I didn't know we'd have to switch wagons to get to Forway, either." "The first wagon was going east, to {WIP-firstWagonStop}. The second one came north, to here." "You sure know a lot about roads."
e6ef23712daa.t: Harry berusaha mencairkan suasana. "Forway besar sekali, ya." Dalila mengabaikannya. Agak gugup, ia melanjutkan: "Aku juga tidak tahu kita harus berganti gerobak untuk sampai ke Forway." "Gerobak pertama pergi ke timur, ke {WIP-firstWagonStop}. Yang kedua datang ke utara, ke sini." "Kamu tahu banyak soal jalan."

e79a988262ba.en: Neferteri dangles the carrot: if Eori doesn't go, she'll throw out Harry's search quest. Eori has no choice but to concede, until a lightbulb goes off in her head: what if she can recreate Harry? Gabiro did it, so why can't she? Neferteri: I suspect she'll dive right into Soul research, just like Gabiro. I'll have to talk with the teachers and steer her away.
e79a988262ba.t: Neferteri mengayunkan wortelnya: kalau Eori tidak pergi, ia akan membuang misi pencarian Harry. Eori tak punya pilihan selain mengalah, sampai sebuah gagasan menyala di kepalanya: bagaimana kalau ia bisa menciptakan ulang Harry? Gabiro berhasil, jadi kenapa ia tidak bisa? Neferteri: Kuduga dia akan langsung terjun ke riset Jiwa, persis seperti Gabiro. Aku harus bicara dengan para guru dan mengarahkannya menjauh.

e8a4c278dfb9.en: Chapter 4 - Anything is a contract away
e8a4c278dfb9.t: Bab 4 - Segalanya hanya sejauh satu kontrak

e9d7ab83ade9.en: He hears someone sneaking away and sees them try to escape through a window, but Takeo catches them, tortures them, and drags them into the forest, where distant screams can be heard.
e9d7ab83ade9.t: Ia mendengar seseorang mengendap-endap dan melihatnya mencoba kabur lewat jendela, tapi Takeo menangkapnya, menyiksanya, dan menyeretnya ke hutan, tempat jeritan-jeritan terdengar dari kejauhan.

ea4f0f0226fe.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit} (the bandit Katsumi killed in Book 7, Chapter 5, now revived): "Hey, do you know where we are?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}: "I have no fucking idea. I just woke up! The door is locked!" He looks around and moves closer. "{WIP-katsumiBandit}, we need to escape through the window!" His worried voice seeps into Harry's ears, waking him.
ea4f0f0226fe.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit} (bandit yang dibunuh Katsumi di Buku 7, Bab 5, kini dihidupkan kembali): "Hei, kamu tahu kita di mana?" {WIP-blackMaginaGuy}: "Aku tidak tahu sama sekali, sialan. Aku baru bangun! Pintunya terkunci!" Ia melihat sekeliling dan mendekat. "{WIP-katsumiBandit}, kita harus kabur lewat jendela!" Suaranya yang cemas merembes ke telinga Harry, membangunkannya.

ec54428c06ae.en: They end up cheering him on: Desmond has been feeling kind of down and regretful, so this will get his head in the game and let him whoop some ass. Harry isn't sure, but they convince him. Hanako gives him a few Pearls to buy a gift or something, and tells him to let loose, since he's been so tense for so long.
ec54428c06ae.t: Akhirnya mereka menyemangatinya: Desmond sedang agak murung dan menyesal, jadi ini akan membuatnya fokus lagi dan bisa beraksi habis-habisan. Harry tidak yakin, tapi mereka meyakinkannya. Hanako memberinya beberapa Pearl untuk membeli hadiah atau semacamnya, dan menyuruhnya bersantai, karena ia sudah begitu tegang begitu lama.

ed3a64ceaa84.en: {WIP-katsumiBandit} slaps his hands away. "You're lying! Touch me again and you'll meet the darkness." {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} grabs his shoulders again, tighter this time, leaning in and raising his voice. "Are you fucking with me? You're not throwing me under the Egua! You're not innocent either! You were the first one abusing them!"
ed3a64ceaa84.t: {WIP-katsumiBandit} menepis tangannya. "Kamu bohong! Sentuh aku lagi dan kamu akan menemui kegelapan." {WIP-blackMaginaGuy} mencengkeram bahunya lagi, kali ini lebih erat, mencondongkan badan dan meninggikan suara. "Kamu mempermainkanku, sialan? Kamu tidak akan menjebloskanku ke bawah Egua! Kamu juga tidak bersalah! Kamu yang pertama menganiaya mereka!"

ee2895c8209c.en: "That's Dalila. She's in the same boat as you, so she'll be staying with us for a while, helping with the woodwork." "Nice to meet you. I'm Desmond," Harry says, with all the effort he can muster. "Nice to meet you too." Dalila's sad voice echoes over the fire; you can feel her broken heart oozing out of it.
ee2895c8209c.t: "Itu Dalila. Nasibnya sama denganmu, jadi dia akan tinggal bersama kami untuk sementara, membantu pekerjaan kayu." "Senang bertemu denganmu. Aku Desmond," kata Harry, dengan segala upaya yang bisa ia kerahkan. "Senang bertemu denganmu juga." Suara sedih Dalila menggema di atas api; kamu bisa merasakan hatinya yang hancur merembes darinya.

f061f52e2366.en: Harry #13-B sprawled on his seat next to Severino, Vitor sitting between them looking conflicted, on the way back with the wood
f061f52e2366.t: Harry #13-B terkapar di kursinya di samping Severino, Vitor duduk di antara mereka dengan raut bimbang, dalam perjalanan pulang membawa kayu

f0fa6b1901f5.en: The captain finishes the contract, grabs a Winga pen, pricks his finger and signs in blood. With a near-mechanical motion, he turns the contract around and lays down another Winga pen for Takeo. "You'll have one Sapphire to investigate the borders of the Hifuna region, and to lay out a plan to keep this from happening again."
f0fa6b1901f5.t: Sang kapten menyelesaikan kontraknya, meraih pena Winga, menusuk jarinya dan menandatangani dengan darah. Dengan gerakan nyaris mekanis, ia memutar kontrak itu dan menaruh pena Winga lain untuk Takeo. "Kamu akan mendapat satu Sapphire untuk menyelidiki perbatasan wilayah Hifuna, dan menyusun rencana agar ini tidak terjadi lagi."

f203de98f962.en: Neferteri tries to intervene, but Itagiba rules it fair, specifically because Eori killed Huneo with nari gels. Neferteri shifts to removing Eori as an apprentice. Huneo doesn't quite get it, but says sure. Eori looks over at her mother: she must be cooking something up again.
f203de98f962.t: Neferteri berusaha menengahi, tapi Itagiba memutuskannya adil, khususnya karena Eori membunuh Huneo dengan nari gel. Neferteri beralih ke mencopot Eori sebagai murid. Huneo tidak terlalu paham, tapi bilang boleh. Eori menoleh ke ibunya: ia pasti sedang merencanakan sesuatu lagi.

f6760149a165.en: Eori and Kibe arrive at the base of Waterfall
f6760149a165.t: Eori dan Kibe tiba di kaki Waterfall

f688f7bb8c33.en: Severino: "Good job, you two. We got some fine wood today." Harry: "For sure. I'm beat." Vitor: "Can we keep this between us?" Severino and Harry listen closely. Vitor tries to say something, but the words just aren't there.
f688f7bb8c33.t: Severino: "Kerja bagus, kalian berdua. Kita dapat kayu yang bagus hari ini." Harry: "Pasti. Aku capek sekali." Vitor: "Bisa kita rahasiakan ini di antara kita?" Severino dan Harry mendengarkan dengan saksama. Vitor mencoba mengatakan sesuatu, tapi kata-katanya tak kunjung keluar.

f68c14b612be.en: Takeo snaps another finger off and starts eating in earnest. Harry screams as blood keeps pulsing from his hand. Like a couch potato devouring a bag of chips, Takeo can't stop snapping off one finger after another. By the fourth, Harry is losing strength, but he's still wide awake to the pain.
f68c14b612be.t: Takeo mematahkan jari lain dan mulai makan dengan sungguh-sungguh. Harry menjerit saat darah terus berdenyut keluar dari tangannya.
