Seperti orang malas melahap sekantong keripik, Takeo tak bisa berhenti mematahkan satu jari demi satu jari. Di jari keempat, Harry mulai kehabisan tenaga, tapi ia masih sepenuhnya terjaga merasakan sakitnya.

f6d93809b3d8.en: On the final stretch to Waterfall, the currents pick up. Eori paddles and paddles, all for naught. Tears form as her arms give out against the current; she fights on with every last bit of her will, but she's losing ground.
f6d93809b3d8.t: Di bentangan terakhir menuju Waterfall, arusnya makin kuat. Eori mendayung dan mendayung, semuanya sia-sia. Air mata terbentuk saat lengannya menyerah melawan arus; ia terus berjuang dengan sisa-sisa tekadnya, tapi ia makin terseret mundur.

f727cf25d4e6.en: Eori rushes him in pure rage; Kibe runs up the stairs, and Eori falls forward and bashes her forehead on a step. Kibe keeps climbing without giving a fuck. Eori takes a deep breath as her anger cools, then climbs after him.
f727cf25d4e6.t: Eori menerjangnya dengan amarah murni; Kibe berlari menaiki tangga, dan Eori jatuh ke depan dan membenturkan dahinya ke anak tangga. Kibe terus mendaki tanpa peduli sedikit pun. Eori menarik napas dalam-dalam saat amarahnya mereda, lalu mendaki mengejarnya.

f7a825c3a4a1.en: Dalila grabs another piece of jerky and starts walking again, deep in thought. Harry follows her slower pace in silence. I'm sorry, but I can't let Eori find out I'm Harry. I'll try to make it up to you—but how?
f7a825c3a4a1.t: Dalila mengambil sepotong dendeng lagi dan mulai berjalan lagi, larut dalam pikiran. Harry mengikuti langkahnya yang lebih lambat dalam diam. Maafkan aku, tapi aku tak bisa membiarkan Eori tahu aku Harry. Aku akan berusaha menebusnya untukmu—tapi bagaimana?

f816ec9643fe.en: Author's to-do: after his soul splits, Harry loses the ability to understand anything in the Vraki language, and has to learn everything again from the beginning.
f816ec9643fe.t: Catatan tugas penulis: setelah jiwanya terbelah, Harry kehilangan kemampuan memahami apa pun dalam bahasa Vraki, dan harus mempelajari semuanya lagi dari awal.

f991cb0d5baf.en: Severino nods, then looks back at Harry with anguish in his eyes. "Looks like you've been through a lot. I can tell. What's your name?" Harry goes through his memories and decides to fake it. "Desmond." "Desmond, do you have any family?" Harry shakes his head. "I—I don't remember anyone." "You're not the only one. If you stay and work with us, we'll give you a bed in the barn, and food." Harry nods. "Thank you."
f991cb0d5baf.t: Severino mengangguk, lalu menatap Harry lagi dengan sorot pedih. "Sepertinya kamu sudah melewati banyak hal. Aku bisa melihatnya. Siapa namamu?" Harry menelusuri ingatannya dan memutuskan berpura-pura. "Desmond." "Desmond, kamu punya keluarga?" Harry menggeleng. "Aku—aku tidak ingat siapa pun." "Kamu bukan satu-satunya. Kalau kamu tinggal dan bekerja bersama kami, kami beri kamu tempat tidur di lumbung, dan makanan." Harry mengangguk. "Terima kasih."

f99b4ff9d8e8.en: Ryo and the sisters in a Forway hotel room
f99b4ff9d8e8.t: Ryo dan kedua saudari itu di kamar hotel Forway

fa5f748b3415.en: Takeo confirms he has the Bagarisa, but he hasn't found the person people spoke of. He tells everyone to watch one another, and not to trust. Severino cuts in: they have a good grasp of the situation, so everyone should calm down. He explains that the other villages are coming to pick up their family and friends, and that anyone who lost their memories will get a hand, if they work their fair share. Takeo steps in: "Unless you're a filthy bandit." Harry's heart skips as Takeo locks eyes with him.
fa5f748b3415.t: Takeo memastikan ia sudah mendapatkan Bagarisa-nya, tapi belum menemukan orang yang dibicarakan orang-orang. Ia menyuruh semua orang saling mengawasi, dan jangan percaya. Severino menyela: mereka sudah cukup memahami keadaan, jadi semua orang sebaiknya tenang. Ia menjelaskan bahwa desa-desa lain akan datang menjemput keluarga dan teman mereka, dan siapa pun yang kehilangan ingatan akan dibantu, asalkan mereka bekerja sesuai bagiannya. Takeo menyela: "Kecuali kalau kamu bandit busuk." Jantung Harry berdegup tak karuan saat Takeo menatap matanya.

fb10e7c26c07.en: Eori's punishment begins at the Sanbi docks
fb10e7c26c07.t: Hukuman Eori dimulai di dermaga Sanbi

fb5ce58c919a.en: Harry says he's never been there—oh, wait, he doesn't have any memories of being there. "Must be hard." Severino: "Not sure I can call you my friend, since we only met yesterday and all, but let's say you're a strong acquaintance." Harry smiles. "I like the sound of that!"
fb5ce58c919a.t: Harry bilang ia belum pernah ke sana—oh, tunggu, ia tak punya ingatan pernah ke sana. "Pasti berat." Severino: "Entah aku bisa menyebutmu temanku, karena kita baru bertemu kemarin dan sebagainya, tapi anggap saja kamu kenalan yang dekat." Harry tersenyum. "Aku suka kedengarannya!"

fd45d83d9488.en: Severino finds Takeo sitting calmly on the bed, Harry against the wall in pain, and the two bandits passed out
fd45d83d9488.t: Severino mendapati Takeo duduk tenang di kasur, Harry kesakitan di dinding, dan kedua bandit pingsan
